description: Renovate bumps tool and image versions in versions.yml, and GitHub Actions digests, and merges every update but a major one by itself once all its checks pass. Hash pins and vulnerability patches are not Renovate's job: the Pins workflow rewrites versions.lock.json and images/locks on Renovate's branches, and refreshes them and the base image digests daily.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the weekly schedule and the release-age wait

customManagers.description: Versions in versions.yml that carry a renovate comment on the line above

packageRules.description: Merge minor, patch and digest updates once every check passes (Renovate checks the results itself, as main has no required checks); a major update waits for review
One weekly pull request for tool bumps, so the Pins workflow repins them together
Stay on the PowerShell 7.6 LTS line; move to the next LTS by hand
Give a new release of the security scanner a week before trusting it
